newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai June offshore loans down 0.3 pct from May.
newsitem.headline: Thai June offshore loans down 0.3 pct from May.

text.p: Total cumulative offshore loans to the end of June granted through the Bangkok International Banking Facility (BIBF) were down 0.3 percent to 1,266 billion baht from 1,269 billion at the end of May, the Bank of Thailand said on Wednesday.
Cumulative BIBF loans at the end of June were 54.6 percent, higher than at the end of June 1995 when loans totalled 819.1 billion baht, the central bank said in a statement.
Outstanding BIBF loans brought in for domestic borrowers rose 0.5 percent to 774.9 billion baht at the end of June from 771.1 billion at the end of May, the bank said.
Cumulative BIBF loans granted to offshore borrowers by the end of June totalled 491.5 billion baht compared with 498.8 billion at the end of May, it said.
